tools.name: search_restaurants
tools.description: Finds restaurants listed in the Yemekhost directory, near a position, in a city or district, or by name, dish or cuisine. Results are restaurant branches with their opening state, rating, distance when a position was given, and whether they deliver to it. Orders are not placed here: every result car

tools.name: get_restaurant
tools.description: Reads one listed branch and the other listed branches of its brand. Identify it by the three slugs a search result carries: tenantSlug, brandSlug and branchSlug. Orders are not placed here: every result carries an orderUrl, the restaurant's own page, where the person places the order.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Lists every city and district that holds a listed restaurant branch, with how many. Use it to find the spelling of a place before searching in it.

tools.name: list_cuisines
tools.description: Lists the cuisines a restaurant can be filed under, with how many listed branches name each. Use a name from it as the cuisine of a search.
